Subject: Sponsor credit policy + suggested reconciliation approach

Sofia / Ben —

Reviewing FinLabs' updated workbook. A few policy notes to keep this consistent across sponsors:

- Redwood sponsor credit policy: sponsor receives credit for leads where the sponsor-origin stamp is present in our event capture AND the lead converts to a qualified opportunity within 30 days of the event. If the lead is routed to a partner/SDR and re-assigned later, we still honor the sponsor-origin stamp if there's no competing paid touch before conversion.
- If vendor CRM uses first-touch and Redwood uses last-touch, we'll surface both metrics but the default payout/reconciliation uses the sponsor-origin + 30-day conversion rule.

For the three deals FinLabs flagged, my read (from HubSpot crosswalk) is:
- DL-2026-0789: sponsor-origin present, conversion 9 days post-event -> eligible for credit
- DL-2026-0803: ambiguous routing -> needs manual review (SDR handoff at T+2 days)
- DL-2026-0821: converted after 45 days -> outside standard window, propose partial credit only if FinLabs can show a paying uplift (we can agree on split).

Proposal: run a final reconciliation doc, agree splits where conversion >30d, then sign off in DocuSign for bookkeeping. I attached the sponsor-credit-policy.md and a clean recon tab we can use.

Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sponsor-credit-policy.md

Hi all —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled the logs. Summary and proposed outcome:

- DL-2026-0789 (HS-9012): Full sponsor credit. Sponsor-origin present; conversion within 9 days.
- DL-2026-0803 (HS-9041): Manual tie-break required — evidence suggests SDR handoff before booth capture; propose 50% credit to FinLabs pending SDR notes.
- DL-2026-0821 (HS-9077): Converted at T+45 days. Not in standard 30-day window. Marissa proposed split (80/20 Redwood/FinLabs) unless FinLabs can show a direct paid uplift attributable to the sponsor.

Requesting FinLabs signoff on these splits so we can close the recon and issue a sponsor credit invoice/adjustment.
